author: blu
body: Phase 1b: an animated land participates in combat. Kormus Bell (AnimateType Black 1 1) makes the controller's Swamp a 1/1 creature; the AI combat path now consults effective-is-creature, so the Swamp is counted, declared as an attacker, and deals its 1 damage to an open opponent. Without the Bell the same Swamp is not a creature -- the AI sees no attacker and deals nothing. This drives the real ai-combat-phase, proving the six combat reads are wired end to end.
